name: kf_open_ss_seq_handle_program_change
summary: Updates active MIDI channel program index and reads next VLQ delta.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_cc_portamento_time

name: kf_open_ss_seq_cc_portamento_switch
summary: Handles MIDI CC 0x41 tone/voice modifier and advances sequence delta.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_cc_all_notes_reverb_off
summary: Handles MIDI CC reverb/all-off control change and advances sequence delta.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_cc_nrpn_lsb
summary: Sets active NRPN parameter index LSB for sequence track Data Entry commands.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_cc_nrpn_msb
summary: Sets active NRPN parameter MSB/mode (0x14 / 0x1e) for sequence track Data Entry.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_cc_rpn_lsb
summary: Handles MIDI CC 0x64 RPN LSB and advances sequence delta.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_cc_rpn_msb
summary: Handles MIDI CC 0x65 RPN MSB and advances sequence delta.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_cc_data_entry
summary: Processes MIDI CC 6 Data Entry for libsnd NRPN subcommands (loops, VAB tone edits, reverb).

name: kf_open_ss_seq_nrpn_ut_dispatch
summary: Dispatches libsnd NRPN Data Entry commands 0..0x16 to mutate VAB tone attributes or reverb.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_handle_pitch_bend
summary: Handles MIDI 0xE0 pitch-bend event for active sequence track.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_handle_meta_event
summary: Handles MIDI 0xFF meta events (0x2f end-of-track loop/stop and 0x51 tempo changes).

name: kf_open_ss_seq_read_vlq_delta
summary: Decodes variable-length quantity (VLQ) MIDI delta timestamp from sequence stream.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_stop_sub_track
summary: Resets sequence track stereo volume and terminates playback cleanly.

name: kf_open_ss_tone_attr_unpack
summary: Unpacks hardware SPU ADSR1/ADSR2 bitfields into decoded ToneAtr fields.

name: kf_open_ss_tone_attr_pack
summary: Packs ToneAtr envelope fields back into hardware SPU ADSR1/ADSR2 16-bit registers.

name: kf_open_ss_vab_get_tone_attr
summary: Copies unpacked VAB ToneAtr structure into caller buffer.

name: kf_open_ss_vab_set_tone_attr
summary: Writes caller ToneAtr fields back into active VAB tone table.

name: kf_open_ss_set_sustain_pedal_on
summary: Sets libsnd global sustain pedal / hold flag state to active (2).

name: kf_open_ss_vab_get_prog_attr
summary: Copies VAB ProgAtr metadata record into caller buffer.

name: kf_open_ss_set_sustain_pedal_off
summary: Clears libsnd global sustain pedal / hold flag state to zero.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_set_fade
summary: Initiates crescendo or decrescendo volume envelope on a single SEQ score.

name: kf_open_ss_sep_set_fade
summary: Initiates crescendo or decrescendo volume envelope on a SEP sub-track.

name: kf_open_ss_sep_set_vol_immediate
summary: Immediately updates SEP track target volume without ramping.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_configure_vol_fade
summary: Configures target volume and step direction for sequence track fade processing.

name: kf_open_ss_set_serial_vol
summary: Configures SPU CD-DA (channel 0) or External audio input stereo mix volume.

name: kf_open_ss_vab_trans_completed

name: kf_open_ss_seq_stop

name: kf_open_ss_sep_stop
summary: Stops active SEP container sub-track playback and keys off its voices.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_stop_track
summary: Stops sequence track playback, resets channel states, and keys off active track voices.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_called_t_by_t_entry
summary: Primary entry prelude falling directly into SsSeqCalledTbyT frame tick processor.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_called_t_by_t
summary: libsnd per-tick dispatcher flushing SPU voices and stepping active SEQ/SEP fades, pauses, and MIDI events.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_update_vol_fade
summary: Interpolates sequence track volume fade-out or ramp step per tick.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_update_pause_state
summary: Applies deferred pause transition state flags on sequence track.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_advance_tick
summary: Steps active sequence track MIDI event queue for one audio tick.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_update_crescendo_fade
summary: Interpolates sequence track volume crescendo ramp step per tick.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_clear_play_flags
summary: Stops track voices and clears sequence track running status flags.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_update_tempo
summary: Interpolates gradual sequence tempo acceleration or deceleration ramp.

name: kf_open_ss_vab_close
summary: Frees allocated SPU waveform memory block and releases VAB ID slot.

name: kf_open_ss_vab_transfer
summary: Opens VAB header and uploads its paired waveform body to SPU RAM.

name: kf_open_ss_seq_close
summary: Closes open SEQ slot, releases its allocation bitmask, and stops track playback.

name: kf_open_ss_sep_close
summary: Closes open SEP slot, releases its allocation bitmask, and stops all tracks.

name: kf_open_spu_set_common_mix_flags
summary: Configures SPU common CD/External audio enable and reverb routing bits via ioctl 0x100.

name: kf_open_spu_init_core
summary: Initializes SPU callbacks, resets SPU hardware/voices, starts IRQ event, and clears reverb flags.

name: kf_open_spu_init
summary: Cold-initializes PlayStation SPU hardware and all 24 voice registers.

name: kf_open_spu_init_hot
summary: Warm-initializes PlayStation SPU hardware without resetting SPU RAM contents.

name: kf_open_spu_start
summary: Hooks SPU DMA Channel 4 callback and opens/enables SPU transfer completion event.

name: kf_open_spu_quit_entry
summary: Entry guard falling into kf_open_spu_quit to disable SPU DMA IRQ and event.

name: kf_open_spu_quit
summary: Disables SPU DMA callback and closes SPU BIOS completion event inside critical section.

name: kf_open_spu_hw_wait_spin
summary: Hardware timing spin delay (240 iterations) after SPU register writes.

name: kf_open_spu_reset_hw_and_voices
summary: Resets SPU control register, mutes master/reverb outputs, and keys off voices.

name: kf_open_spu_disable_dma_irq_cb
summary: Clears SPU DMA completion user callback and detaches DMA Channel 4 callback.

name: kf_open_spu_enable_dma_irq_cb
summary: Attaches SPU DMA Channel 4 completion handler and returns device descriptor 3.

name: kf_open_spu_set_dma_delay_read
summary: Configures SPU bus delay timing register for SPU-to-RAM DMA readback.

name: kf_open_spu_set_dma_delay_write
summary: Configures SPU bus delay timing register for RAM-to-SPU DMA writes.

name: kf_open_spu_write_dispatch
summary: Selects SPU DMA write or manual PIO transfer depending on configured transfer mode.

name: kf_open_spu_pio_write_ram
summary: Transfers data from main RAM to SPU RAM manually via hardware FIFO and polling.

name: kf_open_spu_read
summary: Reads data from configured SPU RAM start address into main RAM via DMA Channel 4.

name: kf_open_spu_dma_irq_handler
summary: SPU DMA Channel 4 completion handler delivering event or calling user transfer callback.

name: kf_open_spu_dma_write_ram
summary: Configures SPU transfer mode and launches DMA Channel 4 upload into SPU RAM.

name: kf_open_spu_dma_read_entry
summary: Entry prelude setting SPU read transfer mode before starting Channel 4 DMA read.

name: kf_open_spu_dma_read_ram
summary: Configures SPU bus read timing and triggers DMA Channel 4 download into main RAM.

name: kf_open_spu_dma_read_at_addr
summary: Programs SPU transfer address and initiates 64-byte block DMA read from SPU RAM.

name: kf_open_spu_device_ioctl
summary: Dispatches SPU driver ioctl commands (FM/noise masks, reverb attrs, common attrs, addr).

name: kf_open_spu_set_voice_attr
summary: Writes masked per-voice SPU MMIO parameters (volume, pitch, addr, ADSR) across 24 voices.

name: kf_open_spu_write_reverb_regs
summary: Writes masked hardware SPU reverb delay/filter/coefficient MMIO registers 0x1f801dc0..1dfc.

name: kf_open_spu_write_common_attr_regs
summary: Writes masked master/reverb/CD/external volume and enable bits to SPU control registers.

name: kf_open_spu_noop_zero
summary: Unused libspu helper stub unconditionally returning zero.

name: kf_open_spu_memcpy_bytes
summary: Local byte-copy helper compiled inside libspu reverb module.

name: kf_open_spu_set_reverb_mode_attr
summary: Validates reverb work area and applies preset reverb mode, depth, delay, and feedback.

name: kf_open_spu_malloc_gc_coalesce
summary: Coalesces adjacent free SPU RAM allocation blocks and compacts free descriptors.

name: kf_open_spu_init_malloc
summary: Initializes SPU RAM allocator table spanning 512KB SPU memory minus reserved header.

name: kf_open_spu_malloc
summary: Allocates aligned block from SPU RAM free list and returns SPU byte address or -1.

name: kf_open_spu_malloc_split_block
summary: Splits SPU heap descriptor block around caller start address and marks range allocated.

name: kf_open_spu_malloc_with_start_addr
summary: Allocates SPU RAM block pinned at a caller-specified byte address.

name: kf_open_spu_addr_in_allocated_range
summary: Checks whether an SPU RAM byte address overlaps any currently allocated SPU heap block.

name: kf_open_spu_check_reverb_workarea_free
summary: Checks if SPU reverb workarea starting address conflicts with allocated soundbank blocks.

name: kf_open_spu_free
summary: Marks SPU heap block free by setting high bit and runs SPU heap coalescing.

name: kf_open_spu_dump_malloc
summary: Prints SPU RAM allocation table slots, addresses, and block byte sizes.

name: kf_open_spu_clear_reverb_work_area
summary: Zeros SPU RAM reverb work area for preset mode when not occupied by soundbanks.

name: kf_open_spu_set_reverb
summary: Enables or disables SPU hardware reverb processing after checking work area validity.

name: kf_open_spu_is_transfer_completed
summary: Polls or waits until pending SPU DMA/PIO memory transfer event completes.

name: kf_open_spu_set_transfer_completed_flag
summary: Sets internal SPU transfer completion state flag according to caller flag.

name: kf_open_spu_is_transfer_idle
summary: Returns non-zero when no SPU RAM transfer is currently marked in-flight.

name: kf_open_spu_set_transfer_mode
summary: Selects SPU DMA (0) or manual PIO (1) transfer mode via driver ioctl 0x21.

name: kf_open_spu_set_transfer_start_addr
summary: Sets SPU RAM transfer start address <= 0x7f000 via driver ioctl 0x2b.

name: kf_open_spu_write
summary: Clamps write size to 0x7f000 and uploads RAM buffer into SPU RAM at start address.

name: kf_slus_main_exec_loop
summary: Resident PS1 overlay loader loop: configures 2MB RAM via SetMem(2), resets ISO9660 FS, loads OPEN.EXE/GAME.EXE/END.EXE into EXEC header 0x80010274 by selector DAT_800102f0, clears s_addr/s_size, enters critical section, executes child overlay, and repeats.

name: kf_slus_crt0_start
summary: SN Systems CRT0 entry (__SN_ENTRY_POINT): zeroes resident .bss 0x80010270..0x800102b4, saves BIOS return address into DAT_80010270, initializes main heap at 0x800102b8 (size 0x1e7d4c), and invokes resident main loader loop.

name: kf_slus_enter_critical_section
summary: PS1 BIOS EnterCriticalSection syscall wrapper (a0=1, syscall 0) disabling interrupts before handing control to loaded child executable via Exec().

name: kf_slus_bios_96_remove
summary: PS1 BIOS A0h:72h _96_remove stub tearing down the resident CD-ROM ISO9660 filesystem handler before cleanly re-initializing CD reading or executing an overlay.
